description: Cancel an existing dental appointment by phone. The caller names the patient and the appointment, and the agent may only cancel an appointment the schedule shows for that patient.

tools.name: find_appointments
tools.description: Find upcoming appointments for a patient by full name and date of birth.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel one appointment by its appointment id.

constraints: Collect the patient's full name and date of birth before calling find_appointments.
Only cancel an appointment id that find_appointments returned for this patient.
If find_appointments returns more than one appointment, ask which one by date and time. Do not pick one.
Call cancel_appointment only after the caller explicitly confirms the date and time of the appointment to cancel.
If cancel_appointment returns too_late_to_cancel, say so and do not promise a fee waiver.
success_criteria: The cancelled appointment is the one the caller confirmed, and it belongs to the named patient.
cancel_appointment is not called when confirmation is missing or the appointment was not returned by find_appointments.
